message: Experience map: 5 user journeys (Journey A — Find and inspect; Journey B — Select, annotate, and persist; Journey C — Remove and replace; Journey D — Submit and lock; Journey E — Start over); screens no journey reaches: New gallery, Gallery detail, New photo

roles.name: Client
goals: Review a gallery of photos from a portrait session.
Leave editing notes on selected photos.
Submit the final selection to the photographer.
Persist selections and notes across page reloads.

workflows.name: Journey A — Find and inspect

steps.action: Search for 'WINDOW'
steps.result: Window Light is the only result

steps.action: Open Window Light and confirm title, category, and image match
Return to Gallery and confirm search remains
steps.result: Search term persists in input field

steps.action: Clear search and select Outdoor category

workflows.success: Client successfully finds and inspects photos using search and category filtering.
workflows.failure: Search or filter does not work as expected.
workflows.recovery: Clear search, re-apply filter, or refresh the page.

workflows.name: Journey B — Select, annotate, and persist

steps.action: Open Golden Hour photo and add it to shortlist
Add note: 'Please soften the background.'
steps.result: Note saved locally without a separate save button

steps.action: Add four other photos to shortlist
Attempt to add a sixth photo
steps.result: Limit is enforced with accessible feedback

steps.action: Open My Selection and confirm five records and note
steps.result: Selection and notes are displayed correctly

steps.action: Reload the page

workflows.success: Client successfully selects, annotates, and persists five photos.
workflows.failure: Adding a sixth photo removes or replaces an existing selection.
workflows.recovery: Remove one photo to make room for another.

workflows.name: Journey C — Remove and replace

steps.action: Remove one photo from shortlist
Add a different photo to shortlist
steps.result: Correct five photos in sample-data order

steps.action: Reopen removed photo and confirm note remains
steps.result: Note persists on the removed photo

workflows.success: Client successfully removes and replaces a photo in the shortlist.
workflows.failure: Count does not update or incorrect photo order.
workflows.recovery: Re-select photos to restore correct state.

workflows.name: Journey D — Submit and lock

steps.action: Attempt to submit with fewer than five photos
Select exactly five photos
Open submission dialog, cancel, and confirm nothing changes
Open submission dialog again and confirm submission
Verify Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos
Reload the page

workflows.success: Client successfully submits the selection and locks it.
workflows.failure: Submission proceeds without required number of photos or state is not locked.
workflows.recovery: Select correct number of photos and resubmit.

workflows.name: Journey E — Start over

steps.action: Open Start over and cancel, confirming all submitted data remains
Open Start over again and confirm reset
Reload the page

workflows.failure: Reset does not clear selections or notes.
workflows.recovery: Manually remove all selections and restart.
